other_conditions: The worker must be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh
The worker must be employed in building and other construction works
The worker must be registered with the Labour Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB)
The worker’s membership must be active
Children must have passed the Class X and XII board or equivalent examinations
One son and one daughter of the registered worker, who secure the highest marks in their district in the Metric examination, are eligible
